subject.size_in_frame: the sh086 frame exactly, unbroken through the throw — the fan leaves her hand, crosses the frame and hits the water off to one side

second_subject.note: the climbing table edge halts where it is, inside this frame, in the same moment the fan leaves her hand.

headroom: stops changing. The headroom that had been closing since sh086 freezes at about 0.14 of frame height and stays there — the visible end of the effect.
horizon_eyeline: Identical to sh086: lens 0.25 m, waterline at 0.78 of frame height. Still no face in frame.

layers.fg: the fan leaving her hand and travelling out of the lower right; the splash where it lands
layers.mg: her empty hand and the water

gaze.note: the only direction in frame is the fan's trajectory, out to the lower right — and the composition follows it nowhere. What matters is what stops behind it.

balance: The near-left mass exits the frame and the far-right line stops moving; the composition arrives at rest in the same instant twice over. The stillness at the end is the narrow escape.
leading_lines: The fan's flight is a single diagonal from centre-left to lower right; the table edge is the level horizontal it frees. One line leaves so the other can stop.
eye_first: The fan flying, then straight back to the table edge — which is not moving any more.
constraint_binding: Required shot (d) of movement 4. The fan stopping and the shrinking stopping happen IN THE SAME FRAME; without that the narrow escape means nothing — so the throw and the arrest of the table edge are both inside the picture, both sharp, with no cut, no reframe and no size change between them.
